question: Is there a storm coming this week?
html:
Storm watch for this week

Yes, on the Jersey Shore, not in Central PA. The National Weather Service has a High Wind Watch and a Coastal Flood Watch for Ocean and Monmouth counties, Punctual Pros' NJ territory, starting late Nov 25 into Nov 26, 2026. Pennsylvania has no active alerts (National Weather Service alerts).

High Wind WatchSevereEastern Monmouth, Coastal Ocean4am Nov 26 to 1am Nov 27
Coastal Flood WatchModerateOcean, Coastal Ocean, Eastern/Western Monmouth6am Nov 26 to 3am Nov 27
  • Forecast east winds of 25 to 35 mph. The gust figure is cut off in our snapshot. Pull the full alert text.
  • Flood watches call for one to two feet of inundation near Monmouth and Middlesex, and two to three feet farther south in Cape May and Cumberland.
  • Certainty is "Possible." These are watches, not warnings. They may be upgraded or dropped.

Central PA outlook

  • No rain or snow is forecast at Lancaster, York, Harrisburg, Carlisle, Reading or Lebanon through Nov 25 (Open-Meteo 7-day forecast).
  • A sharp cold turn is coming. Highs drop from the low 60s on Nov 23 to the mid 40s. Lows reach 19 to 25°F on Nov 25.
  • Gusts near 30 mph are forecast Nov 25. Our snapshot shows only 6 of 10 hubs and stops at Nov 25.

Demand impact

  • Wind and flooding usually drive electrical calls (outages, surge damage, generators) and plumbing calls (water intrusion, sump issues). The first hard freeze of the season usually drives no-heat HVAC calls (est.).
  • We cannot put a call count on this week. The demand model's weather multipliers are uncalibrated assumptions, and PP market share by county is unknown (Punctual Pros demand model).
  • Firm numbers would need 12+ months of PP booked-call history matched to station weather and alert flags.

The storm lands on Thanksgiving, a thin-staffing day. How fast Horvath answers storm calls will shape customer retention and revenue on the NJ side.

Next actions

  • Confirm NJ holiday coverage. Check Horvath's on-call electricians and plumbers for Nov 26 and 27 against the watch window.
  • Load PA trucks for no-heat calls. Stock furnace and boiler parts ahead of the Nov 25 freeze, especially in oil and propane areas such as Lebanon and Lancaster.
  • Re-pull alerts on Tuesday night. Check for watch-to-warning upgrades and the full wind-gust figure.
  • Log this week's booked calls. Tag them by trade and county to start calibrating the demand model.
